description: Header file defining classes and enums for network connectivity management, including endpoint caching, connectivity testing, and monitoring within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: EndpointManager
classes.description: Manages saving and loading network endpoints to/from a cache file.

classes.name: TestConnectivity
classes.description: Performs connectivity tests to determine internet and captive portal status.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: Monitors network connectivity status and manages connectivity checks.

methods.name: writeEndpointsToFile
methods.description: Writes a list of endpoints to the cache file.

methods.name: readEndpointsFromFile
methods.description: Reads endpoints from the cache file.

methods.name: setConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Sets the endpoints used for connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: getConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of endpoints for monitoring.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns the current list of connectivity monitor endpoints.

methods.name: TestConnectivity
methods.description: Constructor for initializing connectivity test with endpoints, timeout, request type, IP version, and interface.

methods.name: getCaptivePortal
methods.description: Returns the URI of the captive portal detected.

methods.name: getInternetState
methods.description: Returns the current internet connectivity status.

methods.name: getCurlError
methods.description: Returns the last cURL error code.

methods.name: checkCurlResponse
methods.description: Checks the response from cURL requests to determine connectivity.

methods.name: checkInternetStateFromResponseCode
methods.description: Determines internet state based on response codes.

methods.name: curlSetOpt
methods.description: Sets options for cURL requests with error handling.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Constructor for initializing network connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: stopConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Stops the connectivity monitoring thread.

methods.name: startConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Starts the connectivity monitoring thread.

methods.name: switchToInitialCheck
methods.description: Switches to initial connectivity check.

methods.name: setConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Sets endpoints for the connectivity monitor.

methods.name: getConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Gets current endpoints for monitoring.

methods.name: getInternetState
methods.description: Retrieves current internet status and interface info.

methods.name: getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Returns the URI of the captive portal.

methods.name: connectivityMonitorFunction
methods.description: Main function running in the monitoring thread.

methods.name: notifyInternetStatusChangedEvent
methods.description: Notifies system of internet status change.
